ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 40:60 ratio of high-intensity white pixels to low-intensity black/dark-grey pixels across the visible ventral area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Left lobe presents a large central white region with high-density dark speckling and a solid black margin. Right lobe presents a smaller, wedge-shaped white region near the trailing edge with significant dark mottling, surrounded by a predominant dark field.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Highly irregular and jagged topography with high-amplitude peaks at the distal tips; trailing edge exhibits a continuous series of fine-grained serrations isolated against the water background.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex trajectory from the visible mid-section toward the tips, significantly distorted by protrusions at the lobe extremities.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-contrast clusters of circular, light-colored pixel groupings localized at the extreme distal tips of both lobes, consistent with barnacle colonization.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive biological encrustations on the distal tips of both fluke lobes, causing significant alteration to the natural trailing edge silhouette.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced bulbous and irregular distal tips caused by dense barnacle clusters.
